digest.component_or_area: Jira Reconciler baseline advance and field arbitration
propositions: Operator local status changes are silently reverted by the reconciler when made in the window between rebar's outbound push and the next pass's baseline advance
The baseline is advanced from the pass-start snapshot before outbound mutations apply, causing it to retain the pre-push value for one pass while local has been changed
The guard `local == baseline` falsely concludes 'local did not change' when baseline lags by one pass, causing inbound to clobber a legitimate operator reopen or un-claim
Per-mutation success must gate baseline advance, not pass exit code, because status transitions can soft-fail while the pass still exits cleanly
The defect affects all five inbound-mirrored fields (summary, description, priority, status, assignee) which share the same `_suppressed_by_inbound` guard and thus the same ABA exposure
